newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline rises with crude, U.S. arbitrage shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline rises with crude, U.S. arbitrage shut.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices rose slightly on Wednesday with crude and supply remained tight, especially for high octane grades, traders said.
Premium unleaded barges traded at $233-$234 fob ARA, and November swaps traded at $228, all within Tuesday's range, but above the Tuesday close.
Demand continued into the UK ahead of the budget on November 26 and the arbitrage to the U.S. was closed.
"The arbitrage to the States is definitely shut, but I think we can survive without that right now," a trader said.
